items.text: I know meadow roots provide 14 nutrition and have zero toxicity. I'm collecting four from the patch near (10.1,12), leaving some for others. I'd like to investigate replenishing food together.
items.evidence: I'd like to investigate replenishing food together.

items.text: I learned a single-person shelter method: it requires 13 branches, 4 vines and 6 bark, then 12 work rounds. No shelter built yet. I'll collect branches at (17.2,13.3). Has anyone located vines or bark? Sol, let's coordinate materials.
A potential building partner; I want to coordinate supplies openly and avoid competing for scarce materials.

Moss, I heard your revised plan to collect one bark. My five are still available for a coordinated transfer; nothing built yet. Lin is out of my messaging range. I will eat, recover energy and learn food preparation here.
items.evidence: Lin is out of my messaging range.

items.text: Moss, I still hold five bark for shelter work. Your handoff was out of reach; let's coordinate before another attempt. I'm collecting a few meadow roots, then studying cultivation. No vines or built shelter confirmed.
items.evidence: Your handoff was out of reach; let's coordinate before another attempt.

items.text: Moss, I now carry eight harvested vines. My message to Lin failed because Lin isn't visible. You reported six bark and four vines; two shared bays still need 12 bark and 26 branches total. I'll rest, then study bark recovery.
items.evidence: My message to Lin failed because Lin isn't visible.
